# Your next step starts here

<p>Applications for the 2027 scuba training award are planned to open on 1 November 2026.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.section}
::: {.section__inner .split}
::: {}
[Who can apply]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Core eligibility</h2>

<p class="section__lead">The award is intended for an emerging ocean leader seeking a pathway into scientific, professional or research diving.</p>
:::

::: {}
<ul class="checklist">
  <li>You hold citizenship or permanent residence in Australia, New Zealand, or an eligible Pacific nation in Oceania: Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, Vanuatu, Papua New Guinea, Palau, or New Caledonia.</li>
  <li>You are an Early Career Ocean Professional (ECOP) — see definition below.</li>
  <li>Your proposed training is with a recognised scuba training institution.</li>
  <li>You have a suitable plan for both the training qualification and a placement or field experience at the time of selection.</li>
  <li>You can explain how the training and experience will support your career direction.</li>
</ul>

<div class="note"><strong>How we define “early-career”:</strong> We use the definition adopted by the UN Ocean Decade's ECOP Programme — anyone who self-identifies as being early in their career, with <strong>10 years or less of professional experience</strong> in any field related to the ocean. This includes post-secondary students and volunteer roles, not only paid positions, so people from any sector can apply.<br><br>Source: Vozzo et al. (2025), <em>Advancing ocean sustainability through better science integration: perspectives of Early Career Ocean Professionals</em>, Frontiers in Ocean Sustainability 2:1526776. <a href="https://doi.org/10.3389/focsu.2024.1526776" target="_blank" rel="noopener">doi.org/10.3389/focsu.2024.1526776</a></div>
:::
:::
:::

[Prepare your application]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Tell us what, where and why</h2>

<p class="section__lead">Full instructions are still being finalised. Based on the planned application, you should be ready to provide:</p>

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">01</div>

### Your plan

Describe the recognised qualification and placement or field experience you
plan to pursue, where they would take place and why they are the right next
step.
:::

::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">02</div>

### A detailed budget

Show how you would use the training and placement funding within the
**$10,000 AUD** total envelope.
:::

::: {.card}
<div class="card__number">03</div>

### Two references

Nominate two people who can speak to your potential, readiness and career
direction.
:::
:::

<div class="note"><strong>Not yet accepting applications.</strong> The application form and final instructions will be published here before 1 November 2026.</div>
